'''Cristian Roig Mauri''' (born 23 July 1977) is a former [[Andorra national football team|Andorran international]] footballer. He was capped for Andorra in 1998.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Andorra - Record International Players |url=https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/ando-recintlp.html |access-date=2026-03-17 |website=www.rsssf.org}}</ref>
